title: Localized tensor comparison closure: Coproduct
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in universe u, A and B be R-algebras, E=A tensor_R B, and C an E-algebra flat over E. Assume derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules. Let Q be an A-K-flat cochain complex, N a C-cochain complex, F termwise extension along A to E to C, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. Let P be the all-representatives, all-models, all-degrees comparison predicate of [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property]. For any I in universe u and G:I to D(A), every coproduct cocone with vertex S has P(S) if P(G(i)) for every i. This includes the empty coproduct. No invertibility of t or of the comparison for Q is assumed.

proof.text: Choose K-flat representatives U_j of G_j by the proved source-library functorial flat resolution. Their coproduct is K-flat: total tensor preserves coproducts by BifunctorColimits, and coproducts of acyclic module complexes are acyclic by stability of quasi-isomorphisms under coproducts. Apply the derived module direct-sum theorem and transport its cocone along the representative isomorphisms. Uniqueness of colimits gives Q(sum U_j) isomorphic to S. These operations are implemented by the proved private helpers exists_kFlat_representative, acyclic_coproduct, and kFlat_coproduct.

Choose models m_j and mS by the existing nonempty model theorem. In degree i, apply the direct-sum comparison square. The hypotheses P(G_j) give IsIso for every summand map alpha_j. Mathlib Limits.Sigma.map_isIso makes Sigma.map alpha an isomorphism. The square and cancellation of its source isomorphism prove IsIso for the comparison of the sum.

For any K-flat V representing S, compose its representative isomorphism with the inverse of Q(sum U_j) isomorphic to S. Apply the representative-square theorem to V and the K-flat sum. Rewrite its commuting square using the invertibility established for the sum, then cancel its target isomorphism with IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right. This is the required all-models, all-representatives, all-degrees predicate. Empty families are included throughout.

theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_closure_coproducts
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) :
    ∀ {I : Type u} (G : I → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
      (S : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (ι : ∀ i, G i ⟶ S),
      CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.mk S ι) →
      (∀ i, localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t (G i)) →
      localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t S
